description:
Stream music, build playlists and find your next favorite with Breezy for iPhone and iPad.

Find something to play
Search for songs, albums, artists and playlists. Explore personal Daily Mixes, Discover Weekly and mood-based music stations shaped by your listening. Choose how much familiar music or discovery you want. JioSaavn and Gaana are additional catalog sources you can turn on or off in Settings.

Keep your favorites close
Like songs, make playlists and follow artists. Search your saved library or save the current queue as a playlist. Add Recently played, Liked songs and Mix widgets to your Home Screen.

Lyrics and sound
Follow synced lyrics where available and tap a timed line to seek. Adjust the equalizer with presets or individual bands for supported audio. Use shuffle, repeat, a sleep timer and optional Crossfade or Automix. Audio quality depends on the source and available formats. Gaana's own HLS streams do not support the equalizer.

Downloads and offline listening
Download supported songs to keep local copies on this device. Open Downloads to manage them, or On this device to find downloads and complete, playable cached songs. Offline playback needs a complete local copy. Cached songs are temporary; downloads stay outside the cache limit until you remove them. Gaana's own HLS streams cannot be downloaded; a matching fallback file from another source may be available. Keep Breezy open while downloads finish.

Your music in Stats
See your listening time, top songs and artists, with genre and language breakdowns where identified. Choose Week, Month, Year or All Time over your saved listening history. All Time includes only history still available in Breezy, not deleted plays. Make a share card from Stats or share a song with its artwork and link.

Your library and iCloud
Your library is saved on this device. Optional iCloud sync shares your library and supported preferences across devices using the same Apple Account and iCloud Drive. Sync starts on when no saved choice exists; a saved Off choice stays off. Current playback, downloaded and cached audio, sign-in and tip records stay on each device. Device backups may include your library.

Music and lyrics depend on external providers and availability. Breezy uses unofficial YouTube Music, JioSaavn and Gaana integrations and is not affiliated with those services. Lyrics are not available for every song.

Optional one-time tips through Apple support development and unlock no features or music.
promotionalText: Stream music, make playlists and explore personal mixes. Follow synced lyrics where available, keep supported songs offline and share your Stats.
